facts.text: Macalester meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted students.

sources.title: Undocumented Applicants - Admissions & Aid - Macalester College
sources.quote: The College meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted students.

facts.text: Under the Macalester Tuition Promise, almost all students with family income below $100,000 receive grants and scholarships covering full tuition.

sources.title: Macalester Tuition Promise - Financial Aid Office
sources.quote: This robust commitment to need-based financial aid has meant that almost all Macalester students with family income below $100,000 are already receiving scholarships and grants that cover full tuition.
